question: Who is designated as the animal within the midst of the yoginī assembly?
premises: Someone situated in the middle of the yoginī group is identified.
That person is called a paśu.
This designation is stated within the Kula tradition.
inference: In the Kula tradition, the one situated in the midst of the yoginī group is called the paśu.
uncertainties: Whether this is literal or symbolic depends on ritual context.
plain_english: In the Kula tradition, he who is situated in the midst of the group of yoginīs is called the animal.
